notes.21: NOTE 21 [SCRATCHED] IT WAS SITTING THERE WHEN I CAME IN. IT WAS SITTING THERE WHEN I LEFT.
notes.26: NOTE 26 [FORM] SUBJECT 3: LAST SEEN FACING THE WALL. DO NOT CORRECT THE RECORD.
notes.28: NOTE 28 [STICKY] When the static folds across the picture, enter the gap. Don't move until it lets you go.
notes.37: NOTE 37 [FORM] PLEASE REMAIN STILL WHILE THE ROOM IS LISTENING. The recording keeps your outline after you leave.
notes.41: NOTE 41 [SCRATCHED] One is a copy. The other is a copy of someone who left. I cannot tell which.
notes.44: NOTE 44 [SCRATCHED] I'm not the first subject here. The voices say they stayed. They sound relieved.
notes.46: NOTE 46 [FORM] DESIGNATION 05: NO SUBJECT ON FILE. Do not let it stand where you stood.

13.name: The Bell Clapper
13.text: RELIC 01 // THE BELL CLAPPER. The chapel bell rang once after its clapper was removed. The sound came from below the house.

33.name: The Sealed Writ
33.text: RELIC 02 // THE SEALED WRIT. A dead lawyer signed this order with a name that has been scraped away. The final line reads: ADMIT THE WITNESS.

47.name: The Negative Frame
47.text: RELIC 03 // THE NEGATIVE FRAME. In the photograph, the wall behind the Warden is a door. A second figure is waiting on the other side.
